short.en: A sweep arm reads a whole run at once

t.zh: 新的一章，新的机器人「扫帚」。它多了一条<part-ref to="sweep"></part-ref>，能一次扫过一整段格子，把整段的数一起送进电路板。
t.en: A new chapter and a new robot: Broom. It has a <part-ref to="sweep"></part-ref> that sweeps a whole run of cells in one go and feeds every number in the run into the circuit board.

t.zh: 一条街上，每家门口放着一些钱。机器人要在每家下面写：从 1 号到这一家，一共有多少钱。
t.en: Along a street, each house has some money at its door. Under each house the robot must write: how much money there is in total from house 1 up to this one.

t.zh: 扫描臂送来的是一整段：接到电路板上的线会变粗。汇合器能直接吃下一整段，段里的每个数都参与。
t.en: What the sweep arm sends is a whole run: its wire on the circuit board is drawn thicker. A Merger can take a whole run directly, and every number in it takes part.

goal.zh: 在每家下面写上：从 1 号到这一家，一共有多少钱。
goal.en: Under each house, write how much money there is in total from house 1 up to this one.

how.zh: 这一关有两个阶段，会检查整行。先用扫描臂；通过后，扫描臂会被收起来。
how.en: This level has two stages and checks the whole row. Use the sweep arm first; once you pass, the arm is folded away.

hints.zh: 在视野下面点<part-ref to="sweep"></part-ref>，读它扫过的那一整段。
hints.en: Click the <part-ref to="sweep"></part-ref> under the view to read the whole run it passes over.

hints.zh: 把这一整段接进「加起来」汇合器，再接到本格。
hints.en: Wire the whole run into a “sum” Merger, then wire that to this cell.

ask.zh: 用扫描臂把 1 号到这一家的钱一次扫进来，加起来。
ask.en: Use the sweep arm to bring in the money from house 1 to this one in one go, and add it up.

body.zh: 可是扫描臂每到一家，都要从 1 号重新扫一遍：第 100 家要读 100 格。
body.en: But at every house, the sweep arm sweeps again from house 1: house 100 means reading 100 cells.

body.zh: 左边那一格，不是已经存着「到上一家一共多少」了吗？下一阶段，扫描臂收起来了。
body.en: Doesn’t the cell on the left already hold “the total up to the previous house”? In the next stage, the sweep arm is folded away.

hints.zh: 到这一家一共的钱 = 到上一家一共的钱 + 这家的钱。
hints.en: Total up to this house = total up to the previous house + this house’s money.

hints.zh: 读「上一格」和「这家的钱」，接进加法器。
hints.en: Read “previous” and “this house’s money”, and wire them into an Adder.

ask.zh: 扫描臂收起来了：只用左边一格和这家的钱。
ask.en: The sweep arm is folded away: use only the cell on the left and this house’s money.

title.en: If the last cell will do, don’t sweep again

body.zh: 两种做法答案一样。可扫描臂在第 n 家要读 n 格，100 户人家一共要读 5050 格；用左边一格，每家只读 1 格，一共 100 格。
body.en: Both ways give the same answers. But the sweep arm reads n cells at house n, so 100 houses take 5,050 reads in all; using the cell on the left, each house reads just 1 cell, 100 in all.

body.zh: 能用上一格存好的答案，就别从头再扫一遍：这是动态规划的老规矩。
body.en: If the previous cell has already stored the answer, don’t sweep again from the start: that is an old rule of dynamic programming.

note.zh: 前缀和：到这一家一共 = 到上一家一共 + 这家。能用上一格，就别重扫。
note.en: Prefix sums: total up to this house = total up to the previous one + this house. If the last cell will do, don’t sweep again.
